questions.stem: What type of reaction joins two amino acids together, and what type of bond does it form?

options.text: Condensation reaction forming a peptide bond
Hydrolysis reaction forming a peptide bond
Condensation reaction forming an ester bond
Hydrolysis reaction forming a glycosidic bond

questions.explanation: Amino acids are joined by a condensation reaction, which removes a water molecule and forms a peptide bond between the amino group of one amino acid and the carboxyl group of another.
